comment: GoldenNugget HotLoad safety rules. Each rule flags a tweak (by its TweakID name) as dangerous/broken, optionally scoped to an iOS version range and device models. 'disabled': false temporarily removes the flag without deleting it. Rules with the special action "kill_app" act as a REMOTE KILL SWITCH: on matching iOS versions/models GoldenNugget refuses to start (or, if already running, shuts itself down like a crash). Scope such rules as narrowly as possible via min_version/max_version/only_models.

rules.reason: Example: disabling these daemons caused a bootloop on iOS 27.x.
